description: React Slingshot application with intentionally attacker-reachable DOM XSS and prototype-pollution flows.

vulnerabilities.description: The About page renders a referral source obtained from document location data as HTML through dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker can execute JavaScript in the application origin by supplying markup through the referral value.

vulnerabilities.description: The home page places a campaign message from the URL into a rich HTML banner using dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker can execute JavaScript in the application origin through a crafted campaign URL.

vulnerabilities.description: The shared-preferences URL loader uses an attacker-controlled section as a dynamic nested property on a plain object before storing the preference.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A crafted section such as __proto__ can modify Object.prototype and influence unrelated application objects.

vulnerabilities.description: The display-preferences loader uses an attacker-controlled section as a dynamic object property before assigning a display setting.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: A crafted section such as __proto__ can write to Object.prototype and create application-wide polluted properties.
